claim: Acquisition of skills and practices associated with symbolic experience and emotional labeling characteristic of rational thinking, ethics, and art become stably internalized epigenetically in brain connectivity and become exclusive of others.
falsifier: The claim can be tested by examining epigenetic markers and brain connectivity changes associated with acquisition of culturally specific skills and practices.

conditions: cultural evolution provides symbolic experience and emotional labeling
exclusions: limited to the reviewed perspective on cultural evolution and epigenetic internalization

title: Acquisition of skills–stable epigenetic internalization mechanism
